fusions.name: Yoke-Breaker
fusions.desc: A head-down heave that deals 26 damage and leaves the target 18% easier to wound for 8 seconds. On a hit, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Plodding Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles with a 30% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Will Not Be Hurried
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Slow-Building Wrath
fusions.desc: After 12 seconds without a critical hit, your critical chance rises by 30% for your next strike.
